in_arabic.name: مفيد
in_arabic.meaning: المفيد اسم يعني النافع والمفيد والمحقق للفائدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: المفيد من الأسماء التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، وهو اسم الفاعل من الفعل 'أفاد'، ويعني النافع والمفيد والمحقق للفائدة. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة النساء آية 111: 'وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّن دُونِهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ وَلَا نَصِيرٍ مُّفِيدٍ'

in_urdu.name: مفید
in_urdu.meaning: مفید کا مطلب ہے مفید، نافع، فائدہ پہنچانے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مفید (Mufid) نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جو کہ مفید ہونے کی خصوصیت رکھتا ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے نافع، فائدہ پہنچانے والا۔ قرآن مجید میں اس نام کی مباشرت ورد نہیں ہوئی، لیکن اس کے معنی اسلامی اقدار کے ساتھ ہم آہنگ ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुफ़िद
in_hindi.meaning: मुफ़िद का अर्थ है - हितकर, लाभदायक, फायदेमंद
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुफ़िद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है। यह नाम उन गुणों को दर्शाता है जो दूसरों के लिए लाभकारी और सहायक होते हैं। इस नाम का महत्व इस्लामी परंपरा में भी है, जहां यह नाम नेक और उपकार करने वाले व्यक्ति की विशेषता को प्रकट करता है।

in_pashto.name: مفید
in_pashto.meaning: مفید د نوم مطلب دی ګټور، نافع، فایده رسونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مفید (Mufid) نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دی، کوم چې ګټور او نافع معنی لري. دا نوم د هغو کسانو ځانګړتیا څرګندوي کوم چې نورو ته ګټه رسوي او د هغوی سره مرسته کوي.

in_english.name: Mufid
in_english.meaning: Mufid means beneficial, advantageous, or profitable
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mufid originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the verb 'afada,' which means to benefit or to be of use. In Islamic tradition, Mufid signifies someone who provides benefit, support, or advantage to others. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the concept of being beneficial is highly valued in Islamic teachings. The name Mufid reflects positive attributes such as kindness, generosity, and helpfulness.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Mufid" holds a significant cultural significance, as it represents the qualities of kindness, generosity, and selflessness. In Islamic culture, the act of giving is highly valued and regarded as a virtue. People with the name "Mufid" are often seen as being warm, approachable, and caring individuals, who strive to provide for and help others. This name is also associated with leadership and authority, as a generous leader is someone who not only supports their people, but goes out of their way to provide for them and create a positive and welcoming environment.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Mufid" lies in its deep connection to the concept of abundance in Islam. The Arabic root 'afida', from which the name is derived, implies not only giving, but also the sense of abundance or plentifulness. As a "Mufid," individuals are reminded to continually give, not only of their material possessions but also of their time, energy, and kindness. This creative, constant giving fosters a deep sense of gratitude and a connection to the divine source from which all blessings originate. It also serves as a reminder that the true beauty and richness of life come not from what one possesses but from the generosity and kindness one bestows upon others.
